@graph.name: 3 Day Ijen, Bromo & Madakaripura Waterfall Discovery from Surabaya

review.reviewBody:
The trip is very good! We enjoyed the planning, the driver, the itenary, the spots we visited, the place we stayed a lot. We feel so lucky to be able to see the blue flame and a clear sky mount Bromo as the weather was good

We are lucky to meet a very friendly driver Rendy. His hospitality made us feel the whole trip to be safe and comfortable.
Also thanks to our Ijen guide Rendy, a young guide with enthusiasm and energy, bringing us up to Ijen all the way.

Will certainly recommend our friends to join Java Volcano Tour in the future when they come to Surabaya!
